mapper.select: SELECT appr_no , appr_emp_no , appr_emp_nm , appr_date , appr_stat , reject FROM approval_m where appr_no = #{appr_no}

SELECT d_seq ,appr_no ,appr_num ,appr_group ,appr_emp_no ,appr_emp_nm ,appr_remarks ,DATE_FORMAT(appr_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as appr_date ,appr_position ,appr_position_seq ,last_tag ,IFNULL(appr_tg,'N') as appr_tg ,(CASE WHEN appr_num = 0 THEN '기안' WHEN IFNULL(appr_tg,'N') = 'N' THEN '확인대기' WHEN IFNULL(appr_tg,'N') = 'T' THEN '확인완료' ELSE '반려' END ) as appr_tg_nm FROM approval_d where appr_no = #{appr_no} ORDER BY appr_num ASC

SELECT z.d_seq ,z.appr_no ,z.appr_num ,z.appr_group ,z.appr_emp_no ,z.appr_emp_nm ,z.appr_remarks ,DATE_FORMAT(z.appr_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS appr_date ,z.appr_position ,z.appr_position_seq ,z.last_tag ,IFNULL(z.appr_tg,'N') AS appr_tg ,z.first_appr_emp_no ,z.first_appr_date ,(CASE WHEN z.appr_group = 'A' AND z.last_tag = 'T' THEN '0107' WHEN z.appr_group = 'B' AND z.last_tag = 'T' THEN emp_no ELSE next_emp_no END ) AS next_emp_no ,(CASE WHEN z.appr_group = 'A' AND z.last_tag = 'T' THEN 'B' WHEN z.appr_group = 'B' AND z.last_tag = 'T' THEN 'C' ELSE 'A' END ) AS next_send_type ,concat(z1.text_1,' ',z1.text_2) as context ,z1.proj_code ,z1.proj_name FROM ( SELECT b.d_seq ,b.appr_no ,a.appr_emp_no AS emp_no ,a.appr_emp_nm AS emp_nm ,b.appr_num ,b.appr_group ,b.appr_emp_no ,b.appr_emp_nm ,b.appr_remarks ,DATE_FORMAT(b.appr_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS appr_date ,b.appr_position ,b.appr_position_seq ,b.last_tag ,b.appr_tg , MAX(CASE WHEN b.appr_num = 0 THEN b.appr_emp_no ELSE '' END )OVER(PARTITION BY a.appr_no) AS first_appr_emp_no , MAX(CASE WHEN b.appr_num = 0 THEN b.appr_date ELSE NULL END )OVER(PARTITION BY a.appr_no) AS first_appr_date , LAG(b.appr_emp_no)OVER(PARTITION BY b.appr_no ORDER BY b.appr_num DESC) AS next_emp_no FROM approval_m a , approval_d b WHERE a.appr_no = b.appr_no ) z,( SELECT a1.appr_no , max(a1.proj_code) as proj_code , max(a1.proj_name) as proj_name , MAX(CONCAT(ADDRESS,' ',ADDRESS_D)) AS TEXT_1 , (CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN CONCAT('외 ',COUNT(*),'건') ELSE '' END) AS TEXT_2 FROM contract_m a1 , contract_d b1 WHERE a1.seq = b1.seq AND a1.appr_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a1.appr_no )z1 where z.d_seq = #{d_seq} AND z.appr_no = z1.appr_no
select IFNULL(MAX(APPR_TG),'N') as appr_tg from approval_d where appr_no = #{appr_no} AND appr_group = 'B' AND last_tag = 'T'

SELECT a.appr_no ,a.emp_no ,a.user_nm ,a.proj_code ,a.proj_name ,a.address ,d.d_seq ,d.appr_num ,d.appr_emp_no ,d.appr_emp_nm ,d.appr_position ,d.first_appr_emp_nm ,d.first_appr_date ,d.next_appr_emp_nm ,d.last_appr_emp_nm ,d.last_appr_date ,d.appr_stat FROM ( SELECT a.appr_no, MAX(a.emp_no) AS emp_no , MAX(a.user_nm) AS user_nm , MAX(a.proj_code) AS proj_code , MAX(a.proj_name) AS proj_name , MAX(a.crtdate) AS crtdate , CONCAT(MAX(CONCAT(b.address,' ',b.address_d)),(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN CONCAT(' 외 ',COUNT(*)-1,'건') ELSE '' END)) AS address FROM contract_m a JOIN contract_d b ON a.seq=b.seq AND a.appr_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.appr_no ) a JOIN ( SELECT c.appr_no ,c.appr_stat ,c.appr_admin ,c.d_seq ,c.appr_num ,c.appr_emp_no ,c.appr_emp_nm ,c.appr_remarks ,c.appr_date ,c.appr_position ,c.last_tag ,c.appr_tg ,c.appr_group ,c.first_appr_emp_nm ,c.first_appr_date ,c.last_appr_emp_nm ,c.last_appr_date ,c.next_appr_emp_nm FROM ( SELECT b.rnum ,b.appr_no ,b.appr_stat ,b.appr_admin ,b.d_seq ,b.appr_num ,b.appr_emp_no ,b.appr_emp_nm ,b.appr_remarks ,b.appr_date ,b.appr_position ,b.last_tag ,b.appr_tg ,b.appr_group ,b.first_appr_emp_nm ,b.first_appr_date ,MAX(CASE WHEN appr_num = last_appr_c_num AND appr_tg = 'T' THEN appr_emp_nm ELSE '' END)OVER( PARTITION BY appr_no) AS last_appr_emp_nm ,MAX(CASE WHEN appr_num = last_appr_c_num AND appr_tg = 'T' THEN appr_date ELSE NULL END)OVER( PARTITION BY appr_no) AS last_appr_date ,(CASE WHEN appr_group = 'A' AND next_appr_emp_nm = '' THEN '업무지원팀' ELSE next_appr_emp_nm END) next_appr_emp_nm FROM ( SELECT a1.appr_no, a1.appr_stat, a1.appr_admin , a2.d_seq, a2.appr_num, a2.appr_emp_no, a2.appr_emp_nm, a2.appr_remarks , (CASE WHEN appr_tg = 'T' THEN a2.appr_date ELSE NULL END) AS appr_date , a2.appr_position, a2.last_tag, IFNULL(a2.appr_tg,'N') AS appr_tg , a2.appr_group , LAG(a2.appr_emp_nm,1,'')OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no ORDER BY a2.appr_num DESC) AS next_appr_emp_nm , MAX(CASE WHEN a2.appr_num = 0 THEN a2.appr_emp_nm ELSE '' END )OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no) AS first_appr_emp_nm , MAX(CASE WHEN a2.appr_num = 0 THEN a2.appr_date ELSE NULL END )OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no) AS first_appr_date , MAX(a2.appr_num)OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no) AS last_appr_num , ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no ORDER BY a2.appr_num DESC) AS rnum , MAX(CASE WHEN a2.appr_tg = 'T' THEN a2.appr_num ELSE 0 END )OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no) AS last_appr_c_num FROM approval_m a1 JOIN approval_d a2 ON a1.appr_no = a2.appr_no ) b ) c WHERE c.rnum = 1 ) d ON a.appr_no = d.appr_no AND d.appr_admin = 'T'

SELECT a.appr_no, a.emp_no, a.proj_name, CONCAT( MAX(CONCAT(b.address, ' ', b.address_d)), (CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN CONCAT(' 외 ', COUNT(*)-1, '건') ELSE '' END) ) AS address, MAX(am.appr_date) as appr_date FROM contract_m a JOIN contract_d b ON a.seq = b.seq JOIN approval_m am ON a.appr_no = am.appr_no WHERE a.appr_no IS NOT NULL AND am.appr_stat = 3 AND a.emp_no = #{user_no} AND a.seq NOT IN ( SELECT dcd.contract_seq FROM draft_contract_detail dcd WHERE dcd.contract_seq IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY a.appr_no,a.proj_name ORDER BY MAX(am.appr_date) DESC

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dcd.appr_no ORDER BY dcd.appr_no SEPARATOR ',') as appr_no_list, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_name, d.proj_code, CONCAT( MAX(CONCAT(COALESCE(cd.address, ''), ' ', COALESCE(cd.address_d, ''))), (CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT dcd.appr_no) > 1 THEN CONCAT(' 외 ', COUNT(DISTINCT dcd.appr_no)-1, '건') ELSE '' END) ) AS address, d.mst_seq, d.id as draft_id, d.created_date, d.cust_reg_attempted FROM draft d LEFT JOIN draft_contract_detail dcd ON d.id = dcd.draft_id LEFT JOIN contract_m c ON dcd.appr_no = c.appr_no LEFT JOIN contract_d cd ON c.seq = cd.seq LEFT JOIN approval_m am ON dcd.appr_no = am.appr_no WHERE (am.appr_stat = 3 OR am.appr_stat IS NULL) AND (d.erp_reg IS NULL OR d.erp_reg = 'N')
AND (c.emp_no = #{user_no} OR c.emp_no IS NULL AND d.emp_no = #{user_no})
GROUP BY d.id, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_code, d.proj_name, d.mst_seq, d.created_date, d.cust_reg_attempted ORDER BY d.created_date DESC

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dcd.appr_no ORDER BY dcd.appr_no SEPARATOR ',') as appr_no_list, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_name, d.proj_code, CONCAT( MAX(CONCAT(COALESCE(cd.address, ''), ' ', COALESCE(cd.address_d, ''))), (CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT dcd.appr_no) > 1 THEN CONCAT(' 외 ', COUNT(DISTINCT dcd.appr_no)-1, '건') ELSE '' END) ) AS address, d.mst_seq, d.id as draft_id, d.cust_reg_attempted FROM draft d LEFT JOIN draft_contract_detail dcd ON d.id = dcd.draft_id LEFT JOIN contract_m c ON dcd.appr_no = c.appr_no LEFT JOIN contract_d cd ON c.seq = cd.seq LEFT JOIN approval_m am ON dcd.appr_no = am.appr_no WHERE (am.appr_stat = 3 OR am.appr_stat IS NULL) AND d.mst_seq IS NOT NULL AND d.mst_seq != ''
AND (c.emp_no = #{user_no} OR c.emp_no IS NULL AND d.emp_no = #{user_no})
GROUP BY d.id, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_code, d.proj_name, d.mst_seq, d.cust_reg_attempted

SELECT d.id as draft_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dcd.appr_no ORDER BY dcd.appr_no SEPARATOR ',') as appr_no_list, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_name, d.proj_code, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CONCAT(cd.address, ' ', COALESCE(cd.address_d, '')) ORDER BY dcd.appr_no SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS address, COUNT(DISTINCT dcd.appr_no) as contract_count, d.mst_seq, d.created_date, NULL as conf_status, NULL as conf_status_name FROM draft d JOIN draft_contract_detail dcd ON d.id = dcd.draft_id JOIN contract_m c ON dcd.appr_no = c.appr_no JOIN contract_d cd ON c.seq = cd.seq JOIN approval_m am ON dcd.appr_no = am.appr_no WHERE am.appr_stat = 3 AND d.mst_seq IS NOT NULL AND d.mst_seq != '' AND (d.erp_reg IS NULL OR d.erp_reg = 'N') GROUP BY d.id, d.emp_no, d.user_nm, d.proj_code, d.proj_name, d.mst_seq, d.created_date ORDER BY d.created_date DESC
SELECT MAX(appr_num) FROM approval_d WHERE appr_no = #{appr_no}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_d ad WHERE ad.appr_no = #{appr_no} AND IFNULL(ad.appr_tg, 'N') = 'T' AND ad.appr_num = (SELECT MAX(appr_num) FROM approval_d WHERE appr_no = #{appr_no})

SELECT cc_id AS ccId, appr_no AS apprNo, emp_no AS empNo, emp_nm AS empNm, position_nm AS positionNm, added_by AS addedBy, DATE_FORMAT(added_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS addedAt FROM approval_cc WHERE appr_no = #{appr_no} ORDER BY cc_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_cc (appr_no, emp_no, emp_nm, position_nm, added_by) VALUES (#{apprNo}, #{empNo}, #{empNm}, #{positionNm}, #{addedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_cc WHERE appr_no = #{appr_no} AND emp_no = #{emp_no}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_d WHERE appr_no = #{appr_no} AND appr_emp_no = #{emp_no}

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_cc WHERE appr_no = #{appr_no} AND emp_no = #{emp_no}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_d WHERE appr_no = #{appr_no} AND appr_emp_no = #{emp_no}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_d WHERE appr_no = #{appr_no} AND appr_group = #{appr_group}

SELECT id, template_code AS templateCode, step_order AS stepOrder, emp_no AS empNo, emp_nm AS empNm, position_nm AS positionNm, is_final AS isFinal, use_yn AS useYn FROM approval_template_step WHERE template_code = #{template_code} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY step_order ASC
